outcome: Accuracy of spot urine albumin creatinine ratio (UACR) compared to 24-hour urine albumin excretion
cohort: 98 antenatal women diagnosed with PE at a tertiary care center
finding: Spot UACR demonstrates higher specificity than sensitivity in detecting proteinuria in women with PE, proving to be a reliable, faster, and accurate method for diagnosis and timely management.
mod_finding: Significant proteinuria was associated with an increased rate of induced labor and cesarean section.
birth_weight: Lower birth weight associated with significant proteinuria
